topic: How can frequency planning address interference between satellite uplinks and broadband power line communication systems?
consensus_response: Frequency planning addresses interference by allocating satellite uplinks to higher frequency bands, implementing exclusion zones, advanced filtering, dynamic allocation, and leveraging propagation characteristics. Beamforming and polarization diversity further reduce interference, while adaptive modulation optimizes spectral reuse based on real-time conditions.
reference_context: SatCom systems operate in various frequency bands, including S, L, Ku, and Ka, with specific uplink and downlink frequencies, requiring careful planning to minimize interference.
